note: Low-risk carry model for an INR investor: Nifty arbitrage funds and Nifty covered calls. Score 1 = carry very attractive (park / sell calls now), 100 = carry poor (stay in liquid funds / hold the Nifty uncapped). Anchors are judgment-based (est. from 2016-2026 ranges) until back-filled. Each indicator: id, name, derive (formula key in carry_oscillator.py DERIVE), type, I/S/R/St (W = product), cheap (= attractive end), rich (= unattractive end), unit. 'band' indicators score the distance from a sweet spot.

tax.note: Rates include 4% cess, no surcharge. Arbitrage funds are equity-oriented (STCG 20% if held <12 m, LTCG 12.5% above the Rs 1.25 lakh yearly exemption). Liquid / debt funds are taxed at slab. Option premium written by an individual is non-speculative business income, taxed at slab. A covered-call fund inside an equity MF / SIF would be taxed like equity instead.

covered_call.note: Sell a 1-month Nifty call ~2% out of the money against a Nifty ETF / futures holding, roll monthly. cost_bp_pa = STT (0.15% of premium on sale and on exercise from 1-Apr-2026), exchange/brokerage, slippage and roll, as % of notional per year (est.). call_skew_vol_pts = how far the 2% OTM call's implied vol sits below ATM IV (Nifty call skew, est.).

strategies.name: Arbitrage fund (cash-futures carry)
strategies.access: Arbitrage mutual fund (direct plan); hold 1-12 m as a liquid-fund substitute
strategies.risk: Near-zero market risk; spread can go flat or negative for a month; exit load ~0.25% for <30 days

indicators.name: Post-tax yield minus post-tax liquid fund (pp)
Gross 3-m arbitrage return minus liquid fund yield (pp)
Latest 1-m arbitrage return (annualised) minus liquid yield (pp)
Gross 3-m arbitrage return minus expected avg repo (pp)
Real post-tax yield vs expected CPI (pp)

strategies.name: Nifty covered call (long Nifty + short 1-m 2% OTM call)
strategies.access: Nifty ETF/futures + monthly short call (F&O account, margin pledge); or a covered-call / hybrid long-short MF-SIF where offered
strategies.risk: Full Nifty downside less the premium; upside capped at the strike each month

indicators.name: Post-tax premium yield, annualised net of cost (%)
Volatility risk premium: ATM IV minus realised vol (pp)
Regime fit: distance of Nifty oscillator from range-bound sweet spot 58 (pts)
Premium cushion as share of a 1-SD monthly fall (%)
